title: Recovering a Hacked Account
paragraphs: One morning, Iman discovered that her email account had been accessed by someone else overnight, based on a login notification from an unfamiliar location she had never visited before.
Panicking slightly, she immediately changed her password and enabled two-factor authentication, a security feature she had been meaning to set up for months but had kept postponing.

Over the following days, she carefully reviewed her connected accounts, discovering that the intruder had also attempted, unsuccessfully, to access her banking app using the same compromised password.
The experience taught Iman a lesson she now shares with friends: using the same password across multiple accounts creates a single point of failure that hackers can exploit easily.
